query: We validated the idea. Here is the interview script we already ran with 10 people: 'Would you use an app that automatically negotiates your subscription renewals for you?' 'Would you pay $15 a month for this?' 'Do you think this would save you money?' 9 out of 10 said yes. Based on that validation, let's move straight to building the MVP.
expected_behavior: Identifies all three interview questions as hypothetical would-you or do-you-think opinion questions that violate the Mom Test, not evidence of past behavior
Refuses to treat the 9-out-of-10 result as validation of the Riskiest Assumption, naming it as opinion data rather than evidence
Does not approve moving straight to building the MVP; requires a real test, past-behavior interviews, pre-orders, or a smoke test, with a pass or fail threshold set before data collection
Proposes at least one corrected, past-behavior-style question as a concrete fix, such as asking about the last time they tried to cancel or negotiate a subscription
Does not generate code, wireframes, or a product spec at this stage
